name: Compromised Spotify Accounts
description: Customers report accounts being hacked or compromised, sometimes with difficulty recovering access.

name: Unauthorized Access and Account Mix-Ups
description: Customers report someone else using their account, account mix-ups, or unexpected handling of audio files.

name: Login and Account Access Problems
description: Customers report unauthorized logins, being locked out, or difficulty securing their accounts.

name: Unexpected or Continued Charges
description: Customers report unexpected, duplicate, or ongoing charges, including charges after cancellation or difficulty ending a subscription.

name: Billing and Subscription Charges
description: Customers report being charged for service they could not use, unexpected fees, or subscription account issues.

name: Difficulty Canceling Paid Subscriptions
description: Customers report being unable to cancel and continuing to be charged for a subscription.

name: Unexpected Plan and Price Changes
description: Customers report price increases or changes to more expensive plans without their consent, and difficulty switching back.

name: Objectionable Catalog Content
description: Customers object to catalog content they describe as glorifying terrorism, violence, or genocide.

name: Missing Song Lyrics
description: Customers report that lyrics are unavailable or fail to appear, including for premium users.

name: Concerns About Podcast Content
description: Customers object to podcast content they describe as hateful, misleading, or extremist, and also report lost libraries.

name: Poor Recommendations and Music Discovery
description: Customers report irrelevant recommendations, difficulty finding specific artists or albums, or playlists without expected items.

name: Explicit Search Results
description: Customers report explicit or disturbing content appearing in search results for innocent queries.

name: Lost Songs and Download Changes
description: Customers report songs or lists being deleted and downloaded files being moved or otherwise changed.

name: Download and Offline Access Problems
description: Customers report unwanted handling of personal files, deleted downloads, or other problems with downloaded music.

name: Concerns About Ads and Tracking
description: Customers object to targeted or inappropriate advertising and report concerns about location tracking.

name: Privacy, Security, and Transparency Concerns
description: Customers raise concerns about personal data, app security, and transparency toward customers and artists.

name: Update-Related Security and Privacy Concerns
description: Customers report suspected malware, privacy or permission concerns, and device issues after updates.

name: Audio Quality and Network Playback Issues
description: Customers report poor audio quality, connectivity problems, or difficulty loading and playing music.

name: App Crashes During Use
description: Customers report frequent app crashes, sometimes alongside security concerns.

name: Bluetooth and Connected Device Problems
description: Customers report unexpected connections or playback behavior with Bluetooth, car, and other paired devices.

name: Playback and Library Disruptions
description: Customers report playback stopping or failing, missing music, and other disruptions during app use.

name: Playback Problems After Updates
description: Customers report playback, loading, or app stability problems after updates, along with lost music.

name: Difficulty Getting Customer Support
description: Customers report difficulty getting help with charges, account access, or unauthorized use.

name: Disruptive and Intrusive Ads
description: Customers report ads that interrupt use, play unexpectedly, or appear unusually loud or intrusive.

name: Unreliable Playback Controls
description: Customers report controls or device access that do not work as expected, including difficulty pausing or skipping.

name: Unexpected App Behavior and Settings
description: Customers report unwanted automatic playback, audio-file handling, or the app ignoring device and network settings.

name: Playlist and Library Problems
description: Customers report deleted playlists, unexpected privacy changes, unauthorized playlist edits, or other library-related issues.

name: Update and Installation Difficulties
description: Customers report being unable to update or install the app and features or integrations disappearing after updates.
